mapper.select: select fie.id fieldId, fie.field_name fieldName, fie.field_code fieldCode, fie.field_type fieldType, rf.sort sort, rf.is_default isDefault, rf.is_basic isBasic, rf.is_visit_basic isVisitBasic, rf.is_dict isDict, rf.dict_type dictType, ta.id tableId, ta.table_code tableCode, ta.table_name tableName, ta.is_loop isLoop, ta.primary_code primaryCode, ta.slave_type slaveType, ta.related_field relatedField, ta.main_table_code mainTableCode, rf.id resultFieldId from cbdses_result_field rf inner join cbdses_table ta on rf.table_code = ta.table_code inner join cbdses_table_field fie on (rf.field_code = fie.field_code and ta.id = fie.table_id) where ta.is_deleted = 0 and fie.is_deleted = 0 and rf.user_id = #{userId} order by rf.sort
